grapeshot.name: Grapeshot
grapeshot.text: Spread shots: +1 per round (5 small stones)

chain_shot.name: Chain Shot
chain_shot.text: Chain shots: +2 per round (cut ropes and wood)

greek_fire.name: Greek Fire
greek_fire.text: Fire shots: +2 per round. Fire spreads 50% faster

powder_keg.name: Powder Keg
powder_keg.text: Exploding shots: +2 per round. +25% blast size

dragons_breath.name: Dragon's Breath
dragons_breath.text: All your shots set wood on fire

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.text: Meteor shots: +1 per round (huge, heavy, burning)

plummet.name: Plummet
plummet.text: Trick: drop straight down. 2 uses per round

turnabout.name: Turnabout
turnabout.text: Trick: reverse direction. 2 uses per round

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.text: Trick: hang still for 1 second. 2 uses per round

ghost_stone.name: Ghost Stone
ghost_stone.text: Trick: pass through segments for 0.5 seconds. 2 uses per round

hawk_dive.name: Hawk Dive
hawk_dive.text: Trick: dive at double speed. 2 uses per round

splinter.name: Splinter
splinter.text: Trick: split into 3. 2 uses per round

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.text: +1 normal shot per royal you killed last round (max 3)

second_volley.name: Second Volley
second_volley.text: Your first shot each round fires twice

arrow_storm.name: Arrow Storm
arrow_storm.text: Once per round: 8 arrows at your aim point (royals only)

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.text: +1 normal shot per royal you lost last round (max 3)

rain_of_ruin.name: Rain of Ruin
rain_of_ruin.text: Once per round: 3 boulders fall on your target's tallest tower

deep_footings.name: Deep Footings
deep_footings.text: +50% strength for segments on the ground

bracing.name: Bracing
bracing.text: +100% rope strength. Ropes can't be cut

hallowed_walls.name: Hallowed Walls
hallowed_walls.text: The first 4 segments hit each round take no damage

masons_discount.name: Mason's Discount
masons_discount.text: Stone and metal cost 1 gold less

counting_house.name: Counting House
counting_house.text: Gain a Counting House: 2 gold per surviving round

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.text: Gain a Watchtower: see next round's wind while it stands

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.text: Gain a Chapel: +1 health per surviving round

royal_mint.name: Royal Mint
royal_mint.text: Gain a Mint: 5 gold per surviving round

cathedral.name: Cathedral
cathedral.text: Gain a Cathedral: royals within 4 segments survive one hit per round

chainmail.name: Chainmail
chainmail.text: Squires survive one hit per round

hardy_stock.name: Hardy Stock
hardy_stock.text: Royals survive falls of up to 5 segment heights

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.text: Gain a Decoy royal (no damage when killed)

plate_armor.name: Plate Armor
plate_armor.text: All royals survive one hit per round

secret_passage.name: Secret Passage
secret_passage.text: Once per round, your first royal killed survives

royal_pardon.name: Royal Pardon
royal_pardon.text: Take 40% less damage from royal deaths

steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
steady_hand.text: Shows the paths of your last 3 shots

sighting_peg.name: Sighting Peg
sighting_peg.text: Shows the start of your arc while swinging
